title: Minimax Lower Bounds for Transported ATE with Partially Observed Covariates and Heavy Tails
banked_reason: D0.5.G: field floor unmet; achieved incremental after paper-score cap 5.4 < 7.4. Full-model sharp n/m frontier and attaining estimator remain open; remote-shell converse has an unresolved fixed-slack submodel scope defect.
gap_reasons: The full-model contribution is a collection of lower bounds, including a novel mixed obstruction and critical logarithm, while the only matched achievability theorem is for a scalar known-design subexperiment. The advertised sharp n-versus-m frontier is therefore not delivered: the shellwise handle is only a construction sketch, with no total estimator or uniform risk bound under unknown rough marginals.

The promised sharp two-sample minimax frontier and total attaining estimator remain explicitly to-prove; the delivered lower envelope is a weaker kernel and does not yet supply the usable full Stat rate/estimator conclusion.

The claimed all-admissible-constants converse silently needs a fixed-slack normalized-score/control-overlap submodel: the proof chooses a constant c0 with c_-<c0<c_+ and room below 1-delta_C, but nonemptiness as stated supplies neither of these particular slack choices; state and prove the required slack submodel (or restrict the theorem), then propagate that scope to the dependent common-smoothness claim.

The claimed new unequal-smoothness lower theorem is not compared theorem-by-theorem with a named closest external result: the related-work discussion names techniques and model classes but does not state the precise prior rate/result and the exact extension.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived and independently audited an unequal-smoothness two-fuzzy lower bound with a critical logarithmic elbow, plus a matched scalar known-design oracle rate. The full-model observable estimator and sharp n-versus-m rate frontier remain open, so the field-floor run stopped at incremental tier. The remote-shell converse has an unresolved fixed-slack submodel scope defect and must not be cited at its current all-admissible-constants scope; the new lower bound also needs theorem-level comparison with the closest published result.
tldr: The transported average treatment effect is identified, and the lower theory now separates target sampling, source outcomes, source conditional covariates, compact conditional projection, and remote mixed obstructions.  A proved two-fuzzy construction with separate smoothness indices \(s\) and \(\eta\) adds the polynomial branches based on \(s+\eta\) and a genuine \(\log(n+1)\) factor at their critical equality.  The sharp minimax frontier remains open because no total shellwise higher-order estimator has yet been proved to attain the combined lower envelope under rough unknown marginals and arbitrary \(n/m\).
gap: Existing partial-covariate transport theory identifies the estimand and gives regular influence-function and bounded-design higher-order results, while covariate-shift regression theory allows Pareto designs only with labeled target outcomes. No located theorem covers the simultaneous outcome-free target, source-only continuous modifiers, polynomial overlap, rough marginal tails, and unequal samples.
fill: The paper will characterize the explicit phase diagram, construct a measurable dyadic-shell higher-order estimator with sparse-cell stabilization and boundary reproduction, and establish matching same-class lower bounds.
